entities.name: Geothermal Energy and Sustainable Development
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Dominica's volcanic geology, including the famous Boiling Lake (the second-largest hot spring in the world), provides significant geothermal energy potential. The government has pursued geothermal development to achieve energy independence and position Dominica as a leader in sustainable development
